title: Headless Beyond the Beef failed (VMS18 255): Ted Gunderson killed before anyone asks the player to look for him

actions.text: Path: Ted Gunderson, held beneath the Gourmand, dies before the player has heard of his disappearance (objective 10 not shown, Mortimer's offer not taken); his OnDeath block (VMS18TedGundersonSCRIPT) sets VMS18 255 (Fail Quest). Stand-ins: travel by move_player (the Gourmand's locked rooms are not walked); the fight by kill.
